project_info.theme: Mixed-media adult streetwear portrait on a night train platform
project_info.creative_direction: Hyper-realistic portrait blended with playful flat chibi companions, hand-drawn outlines, and youthful doodle graphics
project_info.color_palette: black hoodie, gray sweatpants, olive backpack, red-and-white commuter train, station amber, white ink, and black doodles

main_subject.detail: approved adult subject with consistent face and body shape, cool calm expression, holding the strap of an olive backpack with one hand
main_subject.wardrobe: oversized streetwear, layered black hoodie, gray sweatpants, and chunky sneakers
main_subject.companions: several cute 3D chibi versions of the same adult character wearing matching clothes and preserving the same face design

composition_elements.framing: vertical full-body portrait centered on the platform
composition_elements.environment: realistic fictional commuter train side view at night with open doors, bright station lighting, and city-night ambiance
composition_elements.interaction: one chibi sits on the adult subject's shoulder, one climbs the leg, and another peeks from the backpack
composition_elements.graphics: white hand-drawn outline around the subject, scribbles, stars, sparkles, electric sparks, and fictional handwritten slogans such as forever young, night, and gen z vibes

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: overhead fluorescent station fixtures around 4300K with soft cyan night fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: cinematic platform highlights, controlled reflections on the train, readable clothing texture, and playful mixed-media separation

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 35mm lens, hyper-realistic photography blended with clean flat 3D cartoon illustration
technical_specs.finish: natural skin texture, crisp train detail, paper-like doodle linework, subtle grain, and controlled saturation

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-quality mixed-media portrait of a clearly adult person using the approved uploaded person reference, standing coolly on a fictional commuter train station platform at night and holding the strap of an olive backpack with one hand. Preserve the same face and body shape. Dress the adult subject in oversized streetwear: a layered black hoodie, gray sweatpants, and chunky sneakers. Behind them, show a realistic fictional red-and-white commuter train side view with open doors, bright cinematic station lighting, and city-night ambiance. Surround the realistic subject with several cute 3D chibi versions of the same adult character in matching clothes and with the same face: one sitting on the shoulder, one climbing the leg, and another peeking from the backpack. Overlay vibrant hand-drawn doodles, white outlines, playful scribbles, stars, sparkles, electric sparks, and floating fictional handwritten slogans such as forever young, night, and gen z vibes. Seamlessly blend hyper-realistic photography with colorful flat cartoon illustrations.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike realistic subject, real transit logo, real personal handle, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, malformed chibi, broken train geometry, illegible slogans
